integrity: The included checker is reproducible and uses exact integer operations. All three scientific axes received self-review, not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for binary irreducible polynomials with the three named coefficient bits; higher-jet and other finite-field cases are not covered. Literature comparison leaves potential priority risk from alternative signature-based formulations. Numerical checks are finite; proof relies on Artin–Schreier genus and Weil zeta theory.
title: An eight-class trace–cotrace–derivative census for irreducible binary polynomials
